name: Liechtenstein (1921–1937)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of blue and red.
history: The plain blue-red bicolour enshrined in the constitution of October 1921. At the 1936 Berlin Olympics Liechtenstein discovered that its flag was identical to the civil flag of Haiti, and on 24 June 1937 a gold crown was added in the upper hoist to distinguish them.
